items.title: The ascending chain condition holds for quasi-coherent submodules of a coherent module on a Noetherian algebraic space

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the ascending chain condition for quasi-coherent submodules of a coherent module on a Noetherian algebraic space (statement lines 2312-2323). The proof passes to an affine Noetherian scheme etale over the space, notes that stabilisation of the chain can be checked there because equality of submodules is detected after restriction, and concludes by the scheme case. The reduction through the etale cover is the substance, so the claim is H2.
